prompt: A fixed five-node majority-quorum cluster needs three reachable cooperating nodes. Considering only node downtime, which event prevents a majority?

options.explanation: Four nodes remain, enough for a majority.

options.text: Only one particular chosen triple is down.
options.explanation: Any failed triple can prevent the majority; all combinations matter.
Three remain, so node count alone still permits a majority.

options.text: Three or more nodes are down.
options.explanation: At most two remain, so a majority cannot form.

workedExample: Translate the service rule into a threshold count before selecting a probability distribution. Under equal independent downtime chances, sum the binomial tail for all counts that leave too few nodes. Other service failures still need separate analysis.
